text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I've always been chasing after her.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (But now... It's time to overtake her!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond crosses the finish line in
first
place! The unbreakable diamond
has crushed her
rivals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aghhh! Nooo! I can't believe I looooost!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But that was soooo much fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! I had a lot of fun too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And now, we'll get to experience this
thrill many
times over!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, Diamond! You were so
awesome out
there!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text:
That race was the best! Great run,
Satono!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's waiting for you, Dia! C'mon,
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Satono Diamond! Can
you tell
us how you're feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I am very happy to have run such a great
race to
close out my classic year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've spent this past year striving to
achieve my
goal of winning the Classic
Triple Crown, and it
hasn't been easy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
All sorts of things have happened, some

completely unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Could you be more specific?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For example, the weather at the Satsuki
Sho was
worse than I could have
anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Races in the Twinkle Series can be
downright
grueling at times... However,
today's was
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I would also like to thank all of my
opponents
from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe! No, thank you! But I'm not gonna lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeahhh! Kitasan! I'll be here cheering for
you next
time too!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: We'll be rooting for you too, Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
As childhood friends and self-declared
rivals,
have you two decided when your
next showdown
will be?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not yet...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run in the Osaka Hai and take
back the
top spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean she's going for the
Senior Spring
Triple Crown?! Go get it,
Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will! And I hope you'll all be there
watching!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Osaka Hai too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't discussed the plan for
her senior
year yet, let alone her next
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond quickly glances in my
direction
before turning back to the
stands and repeating
herself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run against Kita in the
Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The rivalry between Satono Diamond
and Kitasan
Black continues!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen was only the
beginning... Wooo!
I'll be there to watch
the next one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers erupt from the stands and things
show no
sign of calming down. Kitasan
Black then invites
the other racers into
the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume stand in a line and look
up at
the stands. They raise their hands
and wave to the
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here's to another great year! Hope to
see you all
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for not consulting with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we make it back to the
waiting room,
Satono Diamond bows
deeply in apology.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem with the distance or
timing of
the race. I just need to make
sure this aligns with
her dream of
becoming an illustrious
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: 次の目標は『大阪杯』でいいのか？
次の目標は『大阪杯』でいいの？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Osaka Hai is a G1 race, so I
don't see
any problem with it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I saw Kita in the winner's circle
today... I
realized yet again how amazing
she is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won the race, but I feel like I still
haven't caught
up to her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You saw how the crowd was smiling,
didn't you?
You heard the roar of their
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita's running brings excitement to the
Twinkle
Series. Everyone loves watching
her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that's part of being an
illustrious
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I still don't quite
understand
what exactly an illustrious
runner is supposed to
be like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In Kita's case, maybe it's that special
something
about her when she runs that
makes people want
to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Her style of running has the ability to
draw fans in
and captivate them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think I could induce the same
kind of
wild enthusiasm as a daughter of
the Satono
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her will is strong and unwavering. She's
always
noble and never shows weakness.
choice_data_list: ダイヤにはダイヤのよさがある

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating that those qualities
essentially
mask her efforts. She shines
magnificently, and is
no less impressive
than Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks for saying so... But I'm
okay.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to find out what being
illustrious means
to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How can I contribute to the Umamusume
world as
Satono Diamond?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I continue to watch and
chase after
Kita, I'll be able to figure out
my own path.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do it!
choice_data_list: わかった。次は『大阪杯』だ！
わかった。次は『大阪杯』だね！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still searching for an answer to what it
means to
be illustrious, Satono Diamond
forges ahead into
her senior year.
